title: Compact catalog preview + release screenshots for new models & deprecations
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact preview and hero screenshots set for the model catalog release notes: covers new model entries, migration guidance, and deprecation notices. This ticket focuses on the compact tile/preview variant used in quickstart flows and the release note hero images that surface pricing and migration recommendations. Deliver visual assets, copy variants, and export-ready files for engineering and marketing. Include accessibility contrast checks and a small set of animated GIFs for in-product quickstart. Ensure naming convention and storage location are consistent with catalog asset patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Compact catalog tile mockups approved by PM and Eng (desktop and mobile)
Hero release screenshot with pricing overlay exported in required sizes and optimized for web
Deprecation banner visual with recommended migration path copy available in three copy-length variants (short/medium/long)
All assets uploaded to Drive and linked in this ticket; Figma file has final frames and annotation layer
Engineering receives redlines and export spec; implementation PR references the assets and is ready for integration testing
deliverables: Hero release screenshot: wide/landscape 1400x720 and social preview 1200x628
Pricing overlay assets: separate layer files (PNG export + SVG overlay) and CSS token guidance
Deprecation banner: three copy lengths and two color schemes (warning, muted) exported as PNG/SVG
Three short GIFs (up to 5s) demonstrating quickstart flow with compact preview to model detail
image_specifications: File types: PNG (lossless) for product screenshots, SVG for overlays/icons, GIF for short animations
Color profile: sRGB, 72dpi for web; include a 2x image set for HiDPI exports
Padding/grid: 24px safe margin inside tile; UI chrome should match console tokens (see style tokens link)
Accessibility: AA contrast between text overlays and background, alt text provided in metadata sheet
